newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Securities opens Dallas branch.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Securities opens Dallas branch.

text.p: Southwest Securities Group Inc said Monday it opened a new retail branch office in Dallas and named Melvin Horton Jr. as senior vice president and branch manager.
Located in Southwest's downtown headquarters location, the new branch will serve a client group of high net worth individual investors, the company said.

"Our focus will be on developing long-term relationships and maintaining the highest level of service with our private client group," Horton said. "We are seeking customers who still wish to have an active decision making role in the management of their assets."
With the opening of the downtown branch, Southwest Securities will have four retail locations in Dallas to serve its customers, including the NorthPark, Lakewood and Las Colinas offices.
